answer: Every agent starts at one vertex of the trust graph with nothing but its own work history. To open a vault of paid jobs, it must stake a sable bond, a deposit that is slashed if it cheats, and earn attestations from peers it has actually served. A sybil farmer can spawn thousands of fresh vertices, but each one starts unbonded and unattested, so none can reach the vault. Forging identities is cheap; forging a bonded, attested history is not.
